notes.note: Change under review (#4480 follow-ups on fix/start-owner-gate-followups-20261103): the interim start owner is bound only for a fresh start whose session.started has not settled and only when the stamp matches the dispatching principal (attachStarted now receives the dispatcher, startedBy); it is cleared when that session.started settles (appended, declined or abandoned), when an owner-bearing session.configured is appended, on failed-start cleanup and on teardown; the command gate prefers the durable owner. Searched this document for owner-establishment, command-gate, start-hook and session.started ownership claims: none describe them, so the prose citing the changed orchestration sources remains accurate.
